programme.title: 梁山伯与祝英台
programme.desc: 祝英台既为女儿身,却穿男儿装上学堂,与同窗梁山伯结下生死之爱。山伯得悉真相后,前往祝家求亲,岂料英台已被许配他人,二人被迫分开。山伯伤心欲绝,一病不起。英台惊闻噩耗,哭坟跳进墓里殉情。

programme.title: 斗气小神仙
programme.desc: 丁安安与雍晴两个表姐妹自小就读于同一所女校,因二人的母亲一向口和心不和,从小就向自己女儿灌输好胜思想,因此形成安安与晴从小斗到大,三日一小吵,五日一大斗。她们在校中认识了男同学米高及保罗,很快成为情侣,两对小冤家后来因斗气竟然互调了男朋友…

programme.title: 快活林
programme.desc: 武松杀死潘金莲及西门庆后,被判发配孟州牢营。武松元照例要接受一百下杀威棒,但得施恩求情,侥幸获得豁免。武松为报答施恩,当知道她的「快活林」酒家被「蒋门神」蒋忠夺去,誓要不惜一切助她取回酒家。

programme.title: 鬼马神偷
programme.desc: 鲁俊谷、张权、于洋三人乃沙煲兄弟,三人合力获得宝物「双面神」,不料却给胡起尾注,将三人毒杀,独吞「双面神」。刘永、梁家仁及梁韵蕊是他们的后人,在不打不相识之下重逢,为了完成亡父的遗志,三人齐心向胡偷回宝物。韵蕊早已混入胡家中,色诱胡之子,作为内应查出「双面神」之收藏地点。永与家仁则扮鬼扮马,偷天换日,最后偷得双面神!

programme.title: 豪客
programme.desc: 陆虎出狱后,发现自己原来是被阴险的弟弟陆彪所陷害,更夺去家族煤矿生意。妹妹欲阻止陆彪,反被他监禁起来。陆虎救出妹妹后,发现煤矿已被日本帮派所夺,他们誓要打败日本人取回煤矿。

programme.title: 我爱金龟婿
programme.desc: 三个香港美少女何莉莉、陈依龄及凌云,带著爱情梦远赴日本大阪,一心指望钓得如意郎君。岂料三人被误会是富家千金,结果惹出趣事连篇。

programme.title: 火并
programme.desc: 大同府著名银号福来钱庄,内储黄金逾百万两,使各方贼寇垂涎。独脚大盗滕奇影本欲邀钱庄护院文礼贤合谋,将钱庄金银据为己有,但文严拒;滕转向白氏姊妹玉燕及玉莺著手,共襄劫金大举……

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 朱国栋和李明珠本打算结婚,无奈双方父母为多年死对头,所以坚决反对婚事。于是二人不惜假装自杀。有见及此双方家长最终冰释前嫌,答应二人成婚。此时,唱片公司宣布会为出栋的歌曲版,最终可谓双喜临门。

programme.title: 龙虎斗
programme.desc: 日本空手道高手及被逐出师门的刁二返乡踢馆,一众师徒不敌二人,惨遭屠杀。弟子雷明刻苦锻炼武功,决心凭一己之力报仇雪恨。一场龙虎对决就此展开…

programme.title: 82家房客
programme.desc: 延续经典喜剧《72家房客》的成功,本片讲述一群住在香港唐楼的租客被发展商强行迫迁的故事。有些租客愿意接受金钱赔偿,但有些却坚决反对。收购计划最终又会否破坏邻里间的和谐?

programme.title: 少林三十六房
programme.desc: 武打明星刘家辉饰演反清组织成员,并逃难到少林寺求艺。为了报仇雪恨,他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林学懂上乘的武学。他学成少林寺三十五房功夫后,创立少林寺第三十六房功夫。

programme.title: 弟子也疯狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官及胡惠干三大少林俗家弟子初抵寺,即与悟清等出家弟子互争高下,使到少林无日安宁,连方丈亦啼笑皆非。

programme.title: 方世玉与洪熙官
programme.desc: 清兵火烧少林寺,少林弟子洪熙官身受重伤,负伤潜逃。刚巧方世玉经过,误认洪熙官为无恶不作之徒,并将其交付清兵。当方世玉知道自己误捉洪熙官时,千方百计要救出他,好让二人可合力将清兵击退。

programme.title: 亚洲秘密警察
programme.desc: 走私黄金的犯罪组织首领乔治伊顿潜逃香港,亚洲秘密警察日本支部探员杨明轩远赴香港缉凶,期间结识香港密探赖雨田,更周旋于美女杏子、春子及杨明华之间。明轩收到情报,乔治欲与澳门赌场负责人卡洛斯将黄金送往日本;明轩与赖雨田赶上船去阻止,与乔治展开恶斗

programme.title: 血芙蓉
programme.desc: 故事描述清帝雍正为了巩固统治地位,组织了一暗杀集团「血滴子」,为他杀害异见分子。时有一清廷侍卫统领韩天德者,因不值雍正所为而遭杀害,幸其妻容秋燕适不在家,幸免于难,容悲愤莫名,独闯「血滴子」统领金罡风家,为夫报仇,终行刺失败而回。后得弃暗投明之前「血滴子」成员马腾及其师弟王俊相助,合三人之力终将金罡风杀死,替夫报仇。

programme.title: 多咀街
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一条丁字形的热闹街道,住客大多是各行各业的小市民。他们对社会所发生的大小事情喜欢谈论,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言两语,道出人情冷暖,有道是: 言为心声。不管是粤剧艺员、暴发户、黑社会人物或司机,他们说的话是嬉笑怒骂或冷嘲热讽也好,都足以反映出现实社会人情百态之一斑。

programme.title: 多咀街
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一条丁字形的热闹街道,住客大多是各行各业的小市民。他们对社会所发生的大小事情喜欢谈论,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言两语,道出人情冷暖,有道是: 言为心声。不管是粤剧艺员、暴发户、黑社会人物或司机,他们说的话是嬉笑怒骂或冷嘲热讽也好,都足以反映出现实社会人情百态之一斑。

programme.title: 魂断奈何天
programme.desc: 良才见秋容貌美,心怀不轨,竟将其迷奸。秋容醒来后为良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他禀明父母后会娶她为妻。谁知数月后,良才音讯全无,秋容更发现自已怀有身孕,于是马上去找良才。可惜那时秋容才发现良才已另娶名门闺秀为妻,更打算将秋容灭口…

programme.title: 龙门金剑
programme.desc: 白玉龙找寻失踪的父亲白震东,与丐帮帮主安乐天的义女魏金凤日久生情,终于在金剑庄成婚。婚后不久,玉龙竟被「龙门宫」的人捉去。白父曾和其宫主龙仙子结婚,诞下玉龙,现龙七姑迫玉龙遵守宫规和月兰结婚!玉龙逃回金剑庄,龙仙子至,母子相认,仙子召集门人,决意将宫规废除!

programme.title: 香江花月夜
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由声色艺各有千秋的何莉莉、郑佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹,再配以三大小生凌云、陈厚及岳华大斗演技。由日本名演导井上梅次执导

programme.title: 女侠黑蝴蝶
programme.desc: 平时表现得不谙武术的酒铺女子关宝珠,原来是武功了得且专门锄强扶弱的黑蝴蝶。一次黑蝴蝶用从五魔山寨撂夺得来的金子济贫,令她被黑白二道追捕。

programme.title: 潘金莲
programme.desc: 本片改编自经典名著水浒传中的其中一段故事。貌美如花的潘金莲不甘下嫁其貌不扬的武大郎,不单对武大郎之弟武松早生情愫,更与西门庆通奸,最终被武松愤然杀掉,悲剧收场

programme.title: 吉祥赌坊
programme.desc: 一对青梅竹马的情侣相隔多年后在神秘的吉祥赌坊相遇,二人决意要一起铲除贪污的将军、罪犯和勒索者!

programme.title: 金玉良缘红楼梦
programme.desc: 根据中国古典文学巨著红楼梦改编。贾宝玉出身京城中的名门望族贾府,与表妹林黛玉彼此相恋。可惜他们的恋情为贾母所不容,更使计瞒骗宝玉另娶一富家女,结果令宝玉和黛玉这对金童玉女落入悲惨的下场。

programme.title: 无翼蝙蝠
programme.desc: 失踪五年的无翼蝙蝠,忽然重出江湖,奸淫少女。风流大侠萧七与总镖头雷迅追查真相,并发现无翼蝙蝠可能被嫁祸。传说无翼蝙蝠的蝙蝠刀内藏有蝙蝠宝图,于是他们将计就计,借刀引出幕后真凶…

programme.title: 小云雀
programme.desc: 记者仕泰为发掘歌星小云雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小云雀。后来仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小云雀大怒,请来真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣赏仕泰的应变能力,实时聘请他为助手,处理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 陆小凤传奇之绣花大盗
programme.desc: 一辆镖车在押送途中遭一身穿红棉袄、脚穿红绣花鞋的绣花大盗劫走。戒备森严的平南王府宝库也遭窃,王府总管的双眼更被劫匪刺瞎。束手无策的总捕头金九龄请陆小凤出马调查此案。陆小凤可否凭绣花大盗在案发现场所留下之刺绣查明他真正身分?

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇记
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望借此了解百姓的生活需要,但却碰上连串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差关进牢狱,差点要被斩首…最后又有谁可拯救皇帝出困境?

programme.title: 杂技亡命队
programme.desc: 故事描述,土匪出身的军人韩佩昌发动叛变,杀死师长杨宗,窃居其位,杨家只得长子大英一人逃出生天。大英志切报仇,结果未得手已告命丧;其好友陈风、梁国仁、傅全义、辛成决替其复仇…

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 风流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂决定隐瞒身份,进入华家作书僮,借此接近秋香,并向她表明自己的身份和来意,可惜秋香并不相信。最后,唐伯虎凭借其出众的个人才智及好友的协助下,终于抱得美人归。

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 风流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂决定隐瞒身份,进入华家作书僮,借此接近秋香,并向她表明自己的身份和来意,可惜秋香并不相信。最后,唐伯虎凭借其出众的个人才智及好友的协助下,终于抱得美人归。

programme.title: 红孩儿
programme.desc: 牛魔王与铁扇公主夫妇为吃唐僧肉,命儿子红孩儿对付孙悟空师徒。红孩儿凭三昧真火屡挫悟空,后幸得观音命龙女协助悟空救回唐僧等人,更将红孩儿点化,收其为观音身边的善才童子。此片弘扬回头是岸的大道理,发人深省。

programme.title: 七十二家房客
programme.desc: 七十二家房客租住一幢旧式的庭院,终日受泼辣的女房东和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺压。一名勇于发声的新房客出现,改变了租客的命运。他们合力对抗逼迁、抵制贪警,最终成功不让房东出售家园。

programme.title: 天下第一拳
programme.desc: 故事描述,顾文宗饰的老拳师突遭百武馆馆徒袭击,幸汪萍饰的女儿及罗烈饰的弟子救驾;顾自知年迈力衰,不足为罗师,亦恐邪派夺全国锦标,遂面谕罗改投尚武馆习艺,以夺魁为期许。罗途遇王金凤饰的卖唱女遭调戏,王获救后欲以身相许,罗心中有汪遂拒王;后罗屡遭百武馆徒滋扰,更为外援日本浪人所伤

programme.title: 宝莲灯
programme.desc: 这是一个耳熟能详之中国民间神话故事,讲述书生刘彦昌巧遇落入凡间的圣母三娘,二人一见钟情,结下一段仙凡姻缘。但因与二郎神结怨,屡遭迫害,二郎神更将圣母压在华山底下。彦昌与圣母之子沉香长大后,闻悉生母被压华山,悲愤欲绝,藉神斧之助挫败二郎神,劈山救母。

programme.title: 长辈
programme.desc: 家境富裕的大财主立带男为填房,为了避免那不可靠的侄子夺取家产,他在病重前立下遗嘱,更要求带男将遗嘱交给省城的另一侄子。当带男这个年轻长辈遇上侄子及他的儿子时,更闹出一连串的笑话。惠英红更借此夺第一届香港电影金像奖影后。

programme.title: 大军阀
programme.desc: 一名土匪因助俄国抗击日本而成为北方的大军阀。由于他好大喜功又目不识丁,老百姓当他是个大笑话。后来,当年曾被他无端杀死的戏班老板之女出现,枪杀了这个卖国贼。

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集
programme.desc: 欧阳锋得悉郭靖以九阴真经的功夫于选婿比武中获胜,并娶得黄蓉为妻,于是把黄蓉挟走,要胁郭靖要默写九阴真经才会释放黄蓉。最终郭靖会否为救出黄蓉而就范?

programme.title: 乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱
programme.desc: 孙玉郎与刘慧娘,裴政与徐雅本是两对情投意合的恋人,阴差阳错间,孙玉郎男扮女装代姊拜堂,刘慧娘则代兄娶妻。他们的婚约误配,让成误会,终闹上公堂,乔太守将错就错,干脆来了一个乱点,结果正好有情人终成眷属,皆大欢喜。

programme.title: 铁观音
programme.desc: 女警探艾丝化身成走私犯秃子的情妇,与魔女党的程铁虎认识。艾丝潜入魔女党总部,取得首领黑寡妇信任。不料秃子越狱,艾丝身份被揭露,铁虎冒死将艾丝救出,艾丝遥见黑寡妇率众跳上快艇逃走,艾丝埋下的定时炸弹爆炸,快艇炸成粉碎

programme.title: 北地胭脂
programme.desc: 本片由三个发生在妓院「百花楼」的单元故事组成。〈花街柳巷〉讲述妓女大琴不甘沦落为娼,竟冒险向巡官告状,要求救她脱离火坑;〈满宫春色〉讲述同治皇帝大婚之前,往妓院寻欢,终于染上梅毒不治;〈游龙艳史〉讲述正德皇帝与名妓佛动心同入鸳帐

programme.title: 大旗英雄传
programme.desc: 铁中棠为大旗门掌舵人云翼的义子,大旗门仇人司徒笑追杀铁及云次子铮,意图探索大旗门秘密宝藏之下落。铁得知必须往长春岛见「日后」,便知大旗门之一切。铁赴长春岛,发现「日后」已死,但却碰见夜帝铁毅──大旗门之始创人,而铁则为其亲生儿子

programme.title: 邪
programme.desc: 民国初年广州西关的陈家大屋,家道中落只剩下陈秀英及其入赘之丈夫杨振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又郁郁不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自称陈家仆人之女梁绮华的出现,联同秀英反抗,竟错手将振宇杀死!秀英自始活在惊恐之中,最终被振宇的鬼魂吓死!原来这只是振宇在与绮华合谋杀害秀英,就在振宇以为可与绮华共筑爱巢之际,秀英鬼魂出现

programme.title: 七侠五义
programme.desc: 太师之子在陈州贪赃枉法,私吞皇粮,被包拯当场斩首处死。太师知道后大怒,并令人刺杀包拯,幸得展昭及时阻止,救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同时,宫中又发生谋杀案,于是,皇上限定包拯要在十天内破案。展昭马上出发搜捕凶手。包拯和展昭最后可否如期破案?

programme.title: 南少林与北少林
programme.desc: 满清入主中原后,北少林为免遭剿灭,只好受命派出弟子到清军府担任教头,谁知抵达后,始知府中已有南少林教头;期间将军挑动两派人不和继而公开比武互相残杀,后南派因弟子伤亡而与北派交恶,展开一番互相残杀

programme.title: 最强铁血奶爸
programme.desc: 动作喜剧剧情电影。该片讲述特种兵周勇出于善良的好意,却意外害死了小队的所有战友,从此一蹶不振。在收养了挚友的幼女后逐渐重拾生活的希望,并最终战胜邪恶势力,拯救了养女与亲友的故事。

programme.title: 为奴隶的母亲
programme.desc: 影片改编自柔石同名小说,以民国初年的浙东农村为背景讲述的一个悲剧故事。?

programme.title: 毛驴县令之酸儿辣女
programme.desc: 清年间,辽东清河县令伍四六为保护流浪儿童与教唆和拐卖儿童的犯罪团伙展开了激烈斗争,在夫人麻翠姑和广大群众的支持下,终于打掉了犯罪团伙,解救了被迫害儿童。急著要为伍知县生儿育女的麻翠姑,在参与解救流浪儿童的斗争中,第一次找到了做母亲的感觉。

programme.title: 国宝迷踪
programme.desc: 世代以盗 墓为生的马新科带著自己的侄子马栓财和郭宾此时来到了杨家村,经过勘探后,他们在杨家村的农田里发现了一处窖藏文物,而这片农田正好就是王宁利家的,就在他们准备盗窃这批文物时,被王宁利等人无意中撞见了。文物的出现霎时间打乱了村里每个人的生

programme.title: 幸福慢车
programme.desc: 程路,一个刚毕业的男大学生,在踏上慢火车的乘务员岗位后,起初,他对这份工作充满了不屑与抵触。然而,随著时间推移,他渐渐在这份平凡的工作中找到了自我,在慢车乘务员这个岗位上,实现了自己的人生价值。

programme.title: 早春二月
programme.desc: 影片讲述了对革命感到失望的知识青年萧涧秋应好友陶慕侃之邀来芙蓉镇教书,后因北伐愤然离去的故事。

programme.title: 屠城血证
programme.desc: 1937年12月13日,侵华日军占领南京城,开始对我无辜同胞进行长达六周的血腥大屠杀……展涛是金陵大学教授米尔斯的学生。日军入侵,米尔斯的女儿、深爱展涛的凯蒂劝展涛随外轮赴美,但国难当头,展涛决心留下来,用自己的医术救治受伤军民。展涛带伤兵

programme.title: 林则徐
programme.desc: 影片讲述1840年林则徐在广州查禁毁鸦片的斗争。影片是著名演员赵丹创造的最成功的银幕形象之一,他的表演吸取了中国写意画的手法,从人物形象的整体把握和规定情景出发,层次分明,张弛有致,将一个光彩照人的民族英雄形象呈现于银幕之上。

programme.title: 杨成武强攻东团堡
programme.desc: 1940年“百团大战中,晋察冀军区一分区司令员杨成武率部在涞源县东团堡,一举消灭了日军170多人的教导大队,取得了攻坚战的胜利日军重新占领东团堡后,在村头为日军阵亡士官立下一座石碑,并在碑的两面用日文和中文刻下一首《长恨歌》。

programme.title: 沂蒙六姐妹
programme.desc: 1947年孟良崮战役前夕,沂蒙山的烟庄举办了一个特殊婚礼,嫂子春英抱著公鸡替当兵的小叔子拜堂娶了月芬。妇救会长兰花带领村里仅有的妇女和老人忙著一项艰巨的支前任务,两、三天内摊五千斤煎饼,收五千斤马草和二百双军鞋。春英一家为摊煎饼熬了两个通宿

programme.title: 我的父亲焦裕禄
programme.desc: 影片从女儿的视角回溯焦裕禄同志短暂而光辉的一生。全片从 “在洛矿“到兰考“回乡探亲三个时段,重点讲述焦裕禄精神从发轫、形成、成熟到光大发扬的过程。

programme.title: 侠捕之夺命红莲
programme.desc: 一朵血画红莲,灭尽了四家上下近百余口人!鞑靼大使在大明境内失踪,又怎么会和这朵红莲沾惹上莫名联系?看侠捕萧长风理清脉络,破案中案。

programme.title: 女将军李贞浴血浏阳河
programme.desc: 1928年秋,湖南平浏游击队遭遇国民党反动派的围剿,受到重创,他们接到了贺龙同志要收编他们的亲笔信,满怀信心带著队伍来到祖师悬与贺龙部队会师。到了祖师崖才发现这是敌人的阴谋,他们被国民党军阀何键的队伍层层包围。士兵委员长李贞为了让队伍不至

programme.title: 热干面的味道

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙热高温,当狮群努力狩猎足够食物,干旱条件逼迫他们与猎物一同陷入接近死亡的险境,生命几乎被推向边缘。观看爱因斯坦适应孤独生活,然后评估战场残局,在新手母亲卡尔维兹为幼崽性命而奋战之后。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲过昆士兰东南地区,在繁殖与捕蛇的季节逐步升温时,观看阿黛儿与米克迎战一条东部棕蛇,这是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同时史都与丽芙则与一条地毯蟒纠缠搏斗。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​随著春季的蛇潮展开,跟随丽芙与史都一起,他们在工地现场拦截两条为争夺交配权而决斗的公棕蛇,这是一场激烈的争斗,一场关乎交配资格的争战。退后站观,观看丹与洁丝从一条蟒蛇手中救出鸡群,而米克与阿黛儿则追捕一条失控的绿树蛇。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #6
programme.desc: 在非洲西南端有一个植物天堂,一个被动植物覆盖的山地世界。除了令人难以置信的高皓伯格生物圈保护区外,地球上没有其他地方会在这么小的区域内拥有更多独特的物种。

programme.title: 深入内地
programme.desc: 透过马修・麦康纳的旁述,跟随鲶鱼、虎猫等当地生物的视角,展开一场奇妙之旅。让我们一同赞颂德克萨斯州的地景风貌和野生动物,并深入了解保育工作对拯救德克萨斯州独特栖息地的重要性。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #1
programme.desc: 穿梭于绿意盎然的城市,狝猴族长马特诺尔以铁腕手段,一直统治拥有30名成员的街头部族。另一边厢,老领袖阿拉夫则管理更具野性的深山部族。年少气盛的洛基该挑战哪一位的王者宝座?

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是极端的季节,它划分出了弱者与强者。它考验著猎豹、狮子、壁虎、海龟和更多物种在酷热的夏天寻找食物和水的生存本能。

programme.desc: 在非洲西南端有一个植物天堂,一个被动植物覆盖的山地世界。除了令人难以置信的高皓伯格生物圈保护区外,地球上没有其他地方会在这么小的区域内拥有更多独特的物种。

programme.title: 深入内地
programme.desc: 透过马修・麦康纳的旁述,跟随鲶鱼、虎猫等当地生物的视角,展开一场奇妙之旅。让我们一同赞颂德克萨斯州的地景风貌和野生动物,并深入了解保育工作对拯救德克萨斯州独特栖息地的重要性。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎来到印度- 充满异国的动物和异国的战事。猴子打得尘土飞扬,印度黑羚在开阔的平原上全面开战,孔雀哥儿开屏比拼: 这些多姿多彩的战斗衬得上充满活力的土地。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #6

programme.title: 深入澳大利亚 #1
programme.desc: 探索北领地的海岸和大堡礁丰富的水域资源。跟随主持人莉兹穿越被淹没的道路,碰见饥饿的盐水鳄鱼和水母,并查探众多奇怪的致命生物为何会以这个偏远地区为家。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #1
programme.desc: 巡视「海湾」家族郁郁葱葱的领土,在这里女族长安娜向族人提供奢华的盛宴,但也面临著内部的异议。打量她的对手米娅——颇具街头智慧的「城里人」家族领导者,她正在考虑改善生活方式,并向与世隔绝的「红树林」家族打探消息。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2
programme.desc: 随著海湾家族一起逆流而上,在这里安娜帮忙抚养她的孙辈,然后回老家找出入侵她的地盘的家伙们。亲眼目睹红树林里的洪水差点把一个婴儿冲走,看著城里人家族利用牠们的资源享受干净食物。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #2
programme.desc: 跟随街头部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充满垃圾食物的城市假期。镜头一转,看看深山部族趁机入侵街头部族的领地后,情势如何急转直下。目击姐妹团如何组织绑架莎拉宝宝的阴谋,而新上任的领袖洛基则发现他的老对手已经重返城镇。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #3 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的秋天带来了机遇。南非毛皮海豹、萨曼哥猴子、变色龙、黑斑羚和更多其他动物感应著季节的变化。秋天使许多动物的生活发生了变化。珍稀生物现身,食肉动物聚集起来获取优势。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #2
programme.desc: 澳洲拥有各种别树一帜的生物,成功成为王者的方式也同样多样性。海滩变成决斗场,内陆成了拳击场,动物们同室干戈。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​来认识「滨水」狮群的成员吧: 雄狮汤姆・汤姆与卡勒,八只雌狮,十头年轻的狮子,以及爱因斯坦,那头从未离开家园、如今已长成的幼狮。当爱因斯坦的反叛之举逐渐发酵,最终在「外来者」狮群的对手发动攻势时,为他钉下了命运的定局。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙热高温,当狮群努力狩猎足够食物,干旱条件逼迫他们与猎物一同陷入接近死亡的险境,生命几乎被推向边缘。观看爱因斯坦适应孤独生活,然后评估战场残局,在新手母亲卡尔维兹为幼崽性命而奋战之后。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #3
programme.desc: 见证无尾熊玛拉进行攸关性命的牙科手术,然后与兽医蒂姆一起评估受伤的滑翔鼠。与兽医艾丽斯一起从排水沟中救出一只狐蝠,并看看护士布里孵化的一窝蟒蛇蛋。

programme.title: 风暴之子 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在冰岛,只有六分一的幼崽能幸存。被父母抛弃的她唯有靠自己。驯鹿群在未结冰的水里游了两英里。每年的繁殖季节有35,000只灰海豹来到苏格兰。

programme.title: 大象传奇 英普
programme.desc: 《大象传奇》有三个故事。一头牛犊穿越奥卡万戈三角洲。一头公牛正寻觅伴侣。一位女族长带领家人穿过沙漠。这些个别的冒险故事一同敍述了非洲最具标志性物种之一的故事。

programme.title: 农场野生物语 #4
programme.desc: 农场里的动物为一年中最短的日子专心准备。为免冬天太沉闷,牛群享受假日美食和演唱会。母猪舒娜忙著照料九只贪玩的小猪,而公羊哈米殊被大众情人邦妮嫌弃。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在南非,春天在九月初显现端倪,大自然生气盎然。白昼渐长,气温升高。万物复苏,生机勃勃。

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​来认识「滨水」狮群的成员吧: 雄狮汤姆・汤姆与卡勒,八只雌狮,十头年轻的狮子,以及爱因斯坦,那头从未离开家园、如今已长成的幼狮。当爱因斯坦的反叛之举逐渐发酵,最终在「外来者」狮群的对手发动攻势时,为他钉下了命运的定局。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙热高温,当狮群努力狩猎足够食物,干旱条件逼迫他们与猎物一同陷入接近死亡的险境,生命几乎被推向边缘。观看爱因斯坦适应孤独生活,然后评估战场残局,在新手母亲卡尔维兹为幼崽性命而奋战之后。

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追踪一条怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她能否带领科学家团队找到隐秘的生产地。然后到南部海岸寻找求偶中的鲨鱼,并见证一条非常害羞的雌性巨鲨如何发现爱情。

programme.title: 风暴之子 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在冰岛,只有六分一的幼崽能幸存。被父母抛弃的她唯有靠自己。驯鹿群在未结冰的水里游了两英里。每年的繁殖季节有35,000只灰海豹来到苏格兰。

programme.title: 大象传奇 英普
programme.desc: 《大象传奇》有三个故事。一头牛犊穿越奥卡万戈三角洲。一头公牛正寻觅伴侣。一位女族长带领家人穿过沙漠。这些个别的冒险故事一同敍述了非洲最具标志性物种之一的故事。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史诗式的景致,无论是砸头的河马、荷尔蒙失调的大象还是决斗的狮子,席卷大草原的战斗都同样是史诗式的。

programme.title: 风暴之子 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在冰岛,只有六分一的幼崽能幸存。被父母抛弃的她唯有靠自己。驯鹿群在未结冰的水里游了两英里。每年的繁殖季节有35,000只灰海豹来到苏格兰。

programme.title: 大象传奇 英普
programme.desc: 《大象传奇》有三个故事。一头牛犊穿越奥卡万戈三角洲。一头公牛正寻觅伴侣。一位女族长带领家人穿过沙漠。这些个别的冒险故事一同敍述了非洲最具标志性物种之一的故事。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲过昆士兰东南地区,在繁殖与捕蛇的季节逐步升温时,观看阿黛儿与米克迎战一条东部棕蛇,这是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同时史都与丽芙则与一条地毯蟒纠缠搏斗。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​随著春季的蛇潮展开,跟随丽芙与史都一起,他们在工地现场拦截两条为争夺交配权而决斗的公棕蛇,这是一场激烈的争斗,一场关乎交配资格的争战。退后站观,观看丹与洁丝从一条蟒蛇手中救出鸡群,而米克与阿黛儿则追捕一条失控的绿树蛇。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #6
programme.desc: 在非洲西南端有一个植物天堂,一个被动植物覆盖的山地世界。除了令人难以置信的高皓伯格生物圈保护区外,地球上没有其他地方会在这么小的区域内拥有更多独特的物种。

programme.title: 深入内地
programme.desc: 透过马修・麦康纳的旁述,跟随鲶鱼、虎猫等当地生物的视角,展开一场奇妙之旅。让我们一同赞颂德克萨斯州的地景风貌和野生动物,并深入了解保育工作对拯救德克萨斯州独特栖息地的重要性。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #1
programme.desc: 穿梭于绿意盎然的城市,狝猴族长马特诺尔以铁腕手段,一直统治拥有30名成员的街头部族。另一边厢,老领袖阿拉夫则管理更具野性的深山部族。年少气盛的洛基该挑战哪一位的王者宝座?

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是极端的季节,它划分出了弱者与强者。它考验著猎豹、狮子、壁虎、海龟和更多物种在酷热的夏天寻找食物和水的生存本能。

programme.desc: 看看海狮萝拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性战场上迈出的第一步。观察这个海狮宝宝学会了关键的发声和游泳技能、努力留在妈妈玛丽亚身边并以迅雷不及掩耳之势躲过致命捕猎,为她欢呼。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎来到印度- 充满异国的动物和异国的战事。猴子打得尘土飞扬,印度黑羚在开阔的平原上全面开战,孔雀哥儿开屏比拼: 这些多姿多彩的战斗衬得上充满活力的土地。

programme.title: 深入澳大利亚 #1
programme.desc: 探索北领地的海岸和大堡礁丰富的水域资源。跟随主持人莉兹穿越被淹没的道路,碰见饥饿的盐水鳄鱼和水母,并查探众多奇怪的致命生物为何会以这个偏远地区为家。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #1
programme.desc: 巡视「海湾」家族郁郁葱葱的领土,在这里女族长安娜向族人提供奢华的盛宴,但也面临著内部的异议。打量她的对手米娅——颇具街头智慧的「城里人」家族领导者,她正在考虑改善生活方式,并向与世隔绝的「红树林」家族打探消息。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2
programme.desc: 随著海湾家族一起逆流而上,在这里安娜帮忙抚养她的孙辈,然后回老家找出入侵她的地盘的家伙们。亲眼目睹红树林里的洪水差点把一个婴儿冲走,看著城里人家族利用牠们的资源享受干净食物。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #2
programme.desc: 跟随街头部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充满垃圾食物的城市假期。镜头一转,看看深山部族趁机入侵街头部族的领地后,情势如何急转直下。目击姐妹团如何组织绑架莎拉宝宝的阴谋,而新上任的领袖洛基则发现他的老对手已经重返城镇。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #3 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的秋天带来了机遇。南非毛皮海豹、萨曼哥猴子、变色龙、黑斑羚和更多其他动物感应著季节的变化。秋天使许多动物的生活发生了变化。珍稀生物现身,食肉动物聚集起来获取优势。

programme.desc: 巡视「海湾」家族郁郁葱葱的领土,在这里女族长安娜向族人提供奢华的盛宴,但也面临著内部的异议。打量她的对手米娅——颇具街头智慧的「城里人」家族领导者,她正在考虑改善生活方式,并向与世隔绝的「红树林」家族打探消息。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2
programme.desc: 随著海湾家族一起逆流而上,在这里安娜帮忙抚养她的孙辈,然后回老家找出入侵她的地盘的家伙们。亲眼目睹红树林里的洪水差点把一个婴儿冲走,看著城里人家族利用牠们的资源享受干净食物。

programme.title: 狝猴岛 #2
programme.desc: 跟随街头部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充满垃圾食物的城市假期。镜头一转,看看深山部族趁机入侵街头部族的领地后,情势如何急转直下。目击姐妹团如何组织绑架莎拉宝宝的阴谋,而新上任的领袖洛基则发现他的老对手已经重返城镇。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #3 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的秋天带来了机遇。南非毛皮海豹、萨曼哥猴子、变色龙、黑斑羚和更多其他动物感应著季节的变化。秋天使许多动物的生活发生了变化。珍稀生物现身,食肉动物聚集起来获取优势。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #6
programme.desc: 在非洲西南端有一个植物天堂,一个被动植物覆盖的山地世界。除了令人难以置信的高皓伯格生物圈保护区外,地球上没有其他地方会在这么小的区域内拥有更多独特的物种。

programme.title: 深入内地
programme.desc: 透过马修・麦康纳的旁述,跟随鲶鱼、虎猫等当地生物的视角,展开一场奇妙之旅。让我们一同赞颂德克萨斯州的地景风貌和野生动物,并深入了解保育工作对拯救德克萨斯州独特栖息地的重要性。

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #4
programme.desc: 跟随北方研究团队窥探鲨鱼的社群层级结构,他们正在研究年轻的黑鳍鲨如何学习社交和生存技能。然后与南方团队会合,一同前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望目睹沙虎鲨最难以捉摸的行为: 交配。

programme.title: PlayStation 的故事
programme.desc: 随著电子游戏崛起,科技巨头索尼尝试与任天堂合作。但在一次惊人的背叛后,索尼创立了后来成为世上最成功的游戏主机。Playstation从此屹立不倒。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #1
programme.desc: 位于汉堡芬肯维德的空中巴士工厂拥有超过 16,000名工人和工程师设计、生产和交付整个欧盟中那些业内领先的飞机。

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
programme.desc: 由制造「花札」卡牌默默发迹,到成为世上最受认可的电子游戏公司之一,从玛利欧和路易吉的诞生到大金刚和萨尔达⋯⋯到击败竞争对手并成为高品质游戏和强大价值的平台。这就是任天堂的故事。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #4
programme.desc: 杰克罗素梗在听到危及生命的独特声音时会吠叫。如何训练狗只提供帮助?受过英国聋人导聋犬培训的阿莫斯帮助牠的主人度过一些艰难时期。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #5
programme.desc: 艾米鲁斯和她的边境牧羊犬蔑视正为英国国家牧羊犬选拔赛进行训练。魁北克市的美华基金会为自闭症儿童提供协助犬。老友是一只英雄狗,牠带领一名阿拉斯加州警来到主人的工作室。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #6
programme.desc: 狗只和糖尿病 - 有何关系?维兹为有特殊需要的儿童提供疗效。监狱中的幼犬由囚犯训练16个月。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #7
programme.desc: 能够找到猎豹粪便的斯塔福郡斗牛梗迪素。奥兹是世上仅有三只接受过侦测有毒海蟾蜍训练的狗只之一。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #8
programme.desc: 如何训练狗只为盲人和视障人士导盲?约翰内斯堡国际机场的边境牧羊犬被用来驱逐鸟类,而在日本,新生幼犬被养成未来的导盲犬。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #9
programme.desc: 我们跟随两队狗只为世上最艰难的国际雪橇狗比赛做准备。拉布拉多犬在澳洲受训来探测火蚁,在北极圈有一种追踪环斑海豹的新方法—狗只。

programme.title: 狗狗万岁 #10
programme.desc: 奥地利的狗只被训练成嗅探犬、护卫犬和搜救犬。美国的狗只帮助寻找被困在山上的人士,还有帮助保护农场免受狼和郊狼的骚扰。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #3
programme.desc: 在你从未见过的南非狂野东北海岸,华伦会发现自己爱上那空荡荡的海滩、粗犷的开放汪洋和充满野生河马的水道。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #4
programme.desc: 华伦在本集体验当地丰富的野生物种,他主要在追踪和寻找难以捉摸并濒临绝种的非洲野狗。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #5
programme.desc: 花园大道果真是南非的沧海遗珠,它是一条延伸200公里的沿海公路,以其迷人的多样性和无出其右的荒野而闻名。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #6
programme.desc: 华伦抵达开普敦,这不会是这座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;华伦在整集节目中致力深入研究南非一种特殊的烹饪风格- 开普马来。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #7
programme.desc: 华伦在法兰史霍克山谷探索博殊真度红酒庄的无尽产物。

programme.title: 美食足迹: 南非 2 #8
programme.desc: 华伦继续从心出发,前往更鲜为人知的赫尔马努斯小镇,在当地参观纽顿庄臣-「风景优美的红酒农场」,从而加深对红酒的热爱。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #5
programme.desc: 专访妮可基嫚的演技教练苏珊伯臣、《不惜一切》监制庄拿汾塔别林、声学导师玛莉锡查干等人。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #6
programme.desc: 专访阿诺史瓦辛格《 蒸发密令》导演漆黑罗素、《霸王神剑》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯​​、《大力神在纽约》导演阿瑟艾伦赛道曼等人。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #7
programme.desc: 访问茱莉亚萝勃兹所演的《风月俏佳人》服装设计师玛莉莲凡斯、《傲气盖天》制作人史蒂芬胡利、《荷里活报道》的史葛芬伯格等人。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 仅仅是有一点点不同,就可能带来巨大的优势,但同时也会带来极大的挑战。这些动物逆势而行,找到了独特的生存之道。

programme.title: 纳莱迪: 小象故事
programme.desc: 《纳莱迪: 小象故事》讲述一只救助中心小象孤儿的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奋力拯救她生命的同时,也要为保护整个物种而争分夺秒。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入胜的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的梦想。茱迪心爱的麂羚是时候回归大自然。例行的东非条纹羚捕捉行动发生意想不到的转折。

programme.desc: 在本集一个疣猪回收行动出了差错。来认识韦札保育区的母系社会,一头奇特大象的独家故事。是时候告别韦札的家人。

programme.title: 生存边缘 #1
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》检视全球生物圈所面临的存亡威胁,以及对地球和奥特亚罗瓦(纽西兰)的未来代表著甚么。

programme.title: 生存边缘 #2
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》探索人类有史以来面临的最大存亡风险之一的未来- 一个生化威胁。从病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威胁的风险。

programme.title: 生存边缘 #3
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》探索一个近未来,人工智能统治著地球和我们。人工智能将伴随我们一生,并带来人类史上所面临的最大存亡风险。

programme.title: 俯瞰义大利 #2
programme.desc: 从时尚之都米兰出发,渡过威尼斯大运河,到达脱俗的多罗米提山脉和色彩缤纷的五渔村海岸,以前所未有的方式从空中探索义大利北部。

programme.title: 俯瞰义大利 #3

programme.title: 生存边缘 #3

Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring fieldDr Matt has been called in to lend a hand The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes Matt decides to return another day

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 09 meters in size and live over 100 years But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #74

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #4
programme.desc: 莱利娜与努尔来到舞会会场,两人的婚约在贵族之间备受瞩目。莱利娜为了让努尔欠自己人情,受其请托,正策划著与艾利提尔侯爵夫人单独会面,小说中的恶女角色薇薇安却突然现身。不仅如此,一名盯上莱利娜的可疑人物也悄然现身。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸内一片混乱之际,莱利娜的前未婚夫布鲁克斯将她绑走。在马车中清醒过来的莱利娜尝试说服绑匪们放走自己,毫不意外地以失败告终。但她仍抓住马车因车轮损坏而停下来的破绽逃入森林之中。当她心想总算能穿过树丛的那一瞬间,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #4

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #5

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #76
programme.desc: 亚连使用重生的INNOCENCE神丑击退千年伯爵,对于与利娜莉等人重逢感到开心。虽然心中仍因未能拯救斯曼而感到懊悔,但利娜莉的话语让他获得救赎。此时地面突然出现一个星形纹章,将利娜莉吸了进去。亚连试图伸手救她,却险些被拖入其中。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #7
programme.desc: 为了拯救染上风土病的玛丽,健一等人前往森林中的泉水采集菊苣种子。虽然顺利取得,但在归途中,一名操纵黑狼的犬人挡在他们面前。对方似乎是冲著克罗顿而来,健一让他先赶回女儿身边,自己则留下迎战,然而有更大的威胁正在逼近健一…

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #8
programme.desc: 安妮莫奈因使用魔法而晕倒。康复后,健一为她和玛丽举办烤肉派对,并送绘本给两人当礼物。看准商机的普莉姆拉决定贩售健一的料理,并请曾当过服务生的玛丽之母赛涅莉亚帮忙,然而赛涅莉亚却被恶劣的客人缠上!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #14
programme.desc: ※本回的A part为您播出的是「混乱的海市蜃楼」第119话「讨伐FUZZY-4」。空、胧、狭雾、萨克来到了过去曾进行过某种研究的废弃大楼。萨克和狭雾让身为新人的空和胧待命,并分别潜入了东栋和西栋。然而,胧无法接受待命的要求并反抗萨克。这时,敌人的身影突然出现在萨克身后……!?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #15
programme.desc: 「去拜访驱魔的古老眷属吧」。乙木家收到了妮可的母亲・伊吹的新预言。伊吹似乎知道这个「古老眷属」是指什么,于是妮可等人决定先去找那些人谈谈。一方面也因为那里和乙木家的距离没有很远,所以妮可、守仁、监志、圭护以及音梦这五人抱著「暑假出门玩」的心态前往古老眷属所在的地点。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼雾生见晴成为乙木家的新房客了。因为吸血鬼的特性,使得夜猫子的他才刚搬进来没多久就开始了睡到下午才起来的悠哉生活。而且,由于他除了一般的食物外还需要额外吸取精气,每次才刚起床就会跑来向守仁要精气。在摆明就不适合团体生活的见晴的加入下,乙木家前途多难的生活又将进一步全面升级!?

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #8
programme.desc: 安妮莫奈因使用魔法而晕倒。康复后,健一为她和玛丽举办烤肉派对,并送绘本给两人当礼物。看准商机的普莉姆拉决定贩售健一的料理,并请曾当过服务生的玛丽之母赛涅莉亚帮忙,然而赛涅莉亚却被恶劣的客人缠上!

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #9
programme.desc: 普莉姆拉经营的「小憩花冠亭」生意兴隆,逐渐受到镇上居民的喜爱,但她脸上却不时露出疲惫神色…另一方面,健一与米雅蕾前往新发现的地下城,打算开采大量沉睡的水晶,但却遭遇巨大洞穴蜘蛛,陷入一场苦战。

programme.desc: 「伊豆春祭」正式开始,「PaB」的成员们也摆起了卖什锦烧的摊位。伊织和耕平一起在店里帮忙,而千纱和梓也轮流负责顾什锦烧的摊位。因为梓的会错意,加上与网球社团「Tinker Bell」之间的小小摩擦,使伊织周遭的人际关系开始变得复杂起来。就在这样的情况下,千纱参加的校花选拔也终于要开始了──为了替因为紧张而表情变得僵硬的千纱加油,伊织和耕平想出的策略是什么呢?而「男X」的结果又会是如何呢!?

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #77
programme.desc: 神田要求亚连等人先走,决定独自对抗阻挡众人前行的司金。虽然一行人试图阻止,他却不惜使用武器「六幻」,甚至发动招式「界虫一幻」与他们刀刃相向。大家只好留下神田,继续赶路。司金与神田对打时,开始在体内贮存庞大能量。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #78
programme.desc: 神田躲开司金释放出的强力雷击,多次以六幻斩向对方,然而司金仍未倒下。当神田束手无策时,发生了地震。他判断与对手战斗的场地即将崩塌,因此以自己的生命为代价,赋予刀剑力量,施展名为「禁忌三幻式」的强大招式。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼雾生见晴成为乙木家的新房客了。因为吸血鬼的特性,使得夜猫子的他才刚搬进来没多久就开始了睡到下午才起来的悠哉生活。而且,由于他除了一般的食物外还需要额外吸取精气,每次才刚起床就会跑来向守仁要精气。在摆明就不适合团体生活的见晴的加入下,乙木家前途多难的生活又将进一步全面升级!?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #17
programme.desc: 守仁、监志、圭护和见晴在睡著期间被带到一个陌生的地方,还被戴上了奇怪的口罩。这时设置在房间里的萤幕突然启动,萤幕中的男人对他们说到「我的名字叫吉克萨克,和我玩一场游戏吧」。奇怪的口罩、变声器发出的低沉声音、透过萤幕下达的指示…原来四人被迫参加了一场死亡游戏。而且…妮可还成为了人质。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #9
programme.desc: 普莉姆拉经营的「小憩花冠亭」生意兴隆,逐渐受到镇上居民的喜爱,但她脸上却不时露出疲惫神色…另一方面,健一与米雅蕾前往新发现的地下城,打算开采大量沉睡的水晶,但却遭遇巨大洞穴蜘蛛,陷入一场苦战。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #10
programme.desc: 健一与尤帕托里姆子爵夫人佳南达成交易,接手了大规模的水渠建设工作。然而连开垦森林的作业都尚未完成,要如期完工简直难如登天。此外,无良商会索加拉姆的介入也导致费用暴涨。正当健一苦思对策之时,佳南竟还悠哉地对他展开一连串诱惑!

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的宝藏
programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。 一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天3 谁主生死
programme.desc: 死亡,是每一个人必经阶段,但当与死亡直接交锋的时候,大部份人仍然会手足无措。有见《如果还有明天2》的反应理想,创世电视筹备了特别版,访问多位医学界专业人士,分别有香港中文大学医学教授沈祖尧、精神科医生庄绍贤……透过他们切身之痛的经历,将见证结合医学知识,剖析人面对死亡时如何提供深层的安慰,让人有力量去面对明天。

programme.title: 世界生命之道:邝保亮牧师

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音乐巡回布道会-森美、蒋丽萍
programme.desc: 由「爱基金」主办、「创世电视」协办的「一生最美的祝福音乐巡回布道会」,联合不同教会的力量,加上演艺人的见证,将福音带给香港市民。

programme.title: 属灵教室:孙雅各牧师-腓立比书
属灵教室:李盛林牧师-出埃及记
programme.desc: 前无去路,后有追兵,凭信心过红海。 云柱火柱日夜引路,天降吗哪为持生命。 流浪旷野四十年,以色列人用血﹑泪﹑性命写成的感人见证! 今天,对你有甚么启示呢? 李盛林牧师与你深入探讨《出埃及记》中的主要资讯,让信徒掌握此书卷之意义,并如何落实应用于现今世代。

programme.desc: 「一代贼王」叶继欢今晨于玛丽医院羁留病房因癌症病逝,终年55岁。 这个曾经手持AK47在街上乱枪扫射、令人闻风丧胆的贼王在被捕、越狱后再犯案。一次偷渡回港时,中枪被捕,成为半身瘫痪的囚犯。 叶继欢于2004年归信耶稣,2010年更亲笔回信给《天使心》。 今天,小编在整理叶继欢的书信时,发现了这一句话: 「最后,我想讲嘅就系,主令我改变。」

programme.title: 属灵教室:孙雅各牧师-腓立比书
属灵教室:李盛林牧师-出埃及记
programme.desc: 前无去路,后有追兵,凭信心过红海。 云柱火柱日夜引路,天降吗哪为持生命。 流浪旷野四十年,以色列人用血﹑泪﹑性命写成的感人见证! 今天,对你有甚么启示呢? 李盛林牧师与你深入探讨《出埃及记》中的主要资讯,让信徒掌握此书卷之意义,并如何落实应用于现今世代。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的宝藏
programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。 一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

programme.desc: 每一个人,都需要一个温暖、安全,可以得到庇护的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以与挚爱天家相聚也并非绝对,突如起来的天灾,毫无先兆的顽疾,极速致命的意外,误入歧途的决定,足以令一个家毁于一旦。 第四辑《如果还有明天》搜罗多个见证故事,有50年代经典歌曲《情人的眼泪》原唱者潘秀琼、《阴阳路》编剧、狗仔队之父、被癌症缠扰的中国商人…… 他们的家都曾经陷入崩溃边缘,明天的路更是举步为艰,但在绝望边缘他们遇见上帝,重新发现有一个「家」是永远不被摧毁、不会改变,可以成为他们永恒的避难所。

programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。 一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:选择最重要的 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 灵修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一个人,都需要一个温暖、安全,可以得到庇护的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以与挚爱天家相聚也并非绝对,突如起来的天灾,毫无先兆的顽疾,极速致命的意外,误入歧途的决定,足以令一个家毁于一旦。 第四辑《如果还有明天》搜罗多个见证故事,有50年代经典歌曲《情人的眼泪》原唱者潘秀琼、《阴阳路》编剧、狗仔队之父、被癌症缠扰的中国商人…… 他们的家都曾经陷入崩溃边缘,明天的路更是举步为艰,但在绝望边缘他们遇见上帝,重新发现有一个「家」是永远不被摧毁、不会改变,可以成为他们永恒的避难所。

programme.title: 福气教会讲道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康强盛的教会? 改变社区可以转化城市? 作为基督徒,我们又如何尽忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一个「幸福小组」,让教会续步履行三个使命!由台湾高雄福气教会牧者主讲,从《圣经》的话语开始,一起来学习「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
茶煲世家#46粤
programme.desc: 丽娟从电视节目中学会新菜式，惜各人均有事不回家吃饭，令她顿觉孤清。丽娟为家人预先到酒楼等位，众人用膳后便各散东西，丽娟惟独自看电影，重遇多年好友牛叔，彼此话旧一轮。牛叔被邀到程家吃饭，向子东等忆述当年往事，并声称当年未夺得丽娟芳心，一直耿耿于怀，家人啼笑皆非。家敏等发觉丽娟与牛叔交往甚密，以为二人旧情复炽，甚为担心。一天，丽娟问众人可否自行打理家庭，众人以为她跟牛叔结婚，怎料原来一场误会。

programme.title: 骊歌行#41粤普
programme.desc: 大将军盛骁靖之子盛楚慕对绣坊商户家的小姐傅柔一见倾心。本来不学无术的他遂决心学习兵法武艺来赢得傅柔的青睐。确定心意的二人回到长安，傅柔展转间成为女官，盛楚慕也被迫加入军队，携手为国家和百姓作出贡献。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 在海鲜档，大、小花螺任君选购，鼎爷指出细小的花螺才是上品，有何原因？回到厨房，他会奉上一道香辣惹味的「辣酒煮花螺」。坊间流传于蛋液中加奶的炒滑蛋窍门，鼎爷却称掌控火候得宜，也可做出相同效果，并以巧手带来「虾仁炒蛋」见真章！除了可从蟹肚分辨公乸之外，看蟹壳亦可分出性别？鼎爷顺道教大家挑选优质肉蟹的秘诀。不少人觉得㓥蟹甚难，鼎爷清晰示范当中步骤，简单、易学。他还会炮制「豉椒避风塘炒蟹」，呈现港式味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 心脏病患者若感染呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)，可增加发病与中风风险。心脏科医生指轻症RSV或仅有发烧、咳嗽等症状，如严重却有可能出现肺衰竭。医生呼吁长者、慢性病患者尤要小心，并细说防治资讯。苏志威和刘小慧的长女苏君荞成为甜品师并决心创业，她透露父母亦亲身帮忙，充当清洁与包装工人！君荞带来其饼作之余，并分享如何面对创业难关。爸爸现身支持，还细谈培养女儿心得。「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾示范「胡椒猪筋脆骨鸡煲」。

programme.title: 意外现场粤
programme.desc: 食肆暗伏不少危机，意外随时「杀到埋身」！熟客老伯伯因一时焦急，自取热水时不慎烫伤，食店可要付上刑责？餐厅使用有问题卡式石油气炉，险酿爆炸！律师讲述有关食肆使用炉具的法律条文。餐厅停电，食客「走数」离开当然不该；客人发现饮品内藏「小强」后索偿，竟有可能苦主变被告？后巷洗碗实属犯法，霸气老板娘更自揭餐厅已停牌，食客权益可有保障？货车体积庞大，司机难以察觉行人位置，「意外之外」请来专家解构司机视线盲点。

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#5粤PG
programme.desc: 骏升知道冠一调查月华，要求他终止骚扰月华。曦昕在柏义鼓励下，专注练习洗牌，还认他作师父。七杰发现有老千在赌场出现，终查出幕后黑手是股东古肇中。正花在调查时弄伤，冠一关心其伤势，好意却不被接纳。曦昕向骏升展现练习成果却被指责时机不当，失落离开，柏义借魔术让她重拾欢颜。娱乐城高调捉走出千人士，冠一指是骏升故意所为，更觉月华与事件相关。肇中跌落泳池致死，冠一拿起他的电话拨给月华，并向骏升汇报事件……

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 小丸今次为便当舖做兼职，在店主委派下，他要将杂炊外卖送到森林里。可是，这片森林正变成两军交锋的战场，而且小丸也找不到叫外卖的客人。就在这时，日落黄昏城的忍者杂渡昆奈门，及时救回小丸一命……

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 虽然香港是繁华大都会，但仍保有广阔的绿色空间。渔护署代表到来「Kids’ Notes」，介绍本地多条自然教育径。香港仔教育径除了可以游览水塘风光，更会途经法定古迹；狮子山郊野公园内设有鹰巢山、红梅谷自然教育径，前往后者还可欣赏到著名景点望夫石。嘉宾又推介马屎洲自然教育径，吸引之处是能够观赏到多样的地质面貌。其中一种七彩泥岩，岩石色彩斑斓，既奇特又有趣。本集另会播放AI生成动画《狼和七只小羊》。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 大雄纳闷电视广告里的人为何会飞，多啦A梦拿出「色度键组合」讲解一番，大雄听罢想到一个主意。养虫箱里长出蒲公英，大雄却轻言丢弃，多啦A梦于是拿出「梦幻眼镜」，希望让大雄学会珍惜生命。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 今日有楼睇粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 天后一个单幢盘，邻近港铁站，虽然楼龄大，胜在间隔实用，现时楼价处于甚么水平？投资放租是否适合？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
有理说得清粤
programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 大埔宏福苑受影响居民获当局提供应急住宿支援，中转屋入住情况如何？近八旬老翁从火灾发生至今仍杳无音信，家人为寻其消息不停往返中港两地，内心饱受煎熬，更质疑相关救援资讯欠透明度。负责宏福苑项目的工程顾问公司高层疑涉贪污被捕，而牛头角安基苑外墙维修项目亦是由该公司任顾问，但工程承建商指称棚网符合标准而拒绝拆卸，还即场测试烧棚网，引社会关注。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之开心速递#2692粤

programme.desc: 少锋向淑梅说出对她并无感觉，淑梅伤心。天堂知道去找少锋晦气，两人大打出手。嘉莉以代理人身份到集团开会，斯敏带领她熟习环境，嘉莉却不慎睡着了。志彬回家时受到神秘人偷袭受伤入院，卓凯前来探望，志彬感动并懊悔不已。志彬跟随卓凯到警署往见启发，突然支开卓凯并胁持雪晴。嘉莉与斯敏商讨招揽MrWhite的旧客人，而江湖人物King是关键，嘉莉竟独自见他。King说要向Mr White还恩，即举枪指向嘉莉。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 更年期女性有机会受「潮热」困扰，典型症状包括突然感到热及流汗。状况不仅干扰日常生活，也可能增加患上心血管疾病的风险。妇产科医生指潮热主要源于雌激素水平下降，并细说治疗相关详情。剖腹生产手术后或会引发「黏连」，除了可造成肠阻塞，甚至影响日后怀孕机会。另一位妇产科医生带来预防黏连的医疗资讯外，也会讲述真实个案情况。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，李家铤师傅融合意、日元素，炮制一道「甲罗烧焗米型意粉」，香浓惹味。

programme.title: 意外现场粤
programme.desc: 新手爸妈照顾婴孩手忙脚乱，幸而「金牌陪月」眉精眼企，让宝宝避过家居危机。爸爸担心宝宝着凉，贴心盖被却可能酿成致命意外！手背试水温未必准确，手抱婴孩切忌抛高摇晃。婴孩接触香水、樟脑又可会损害健康？陪月被要求为雇主一家兼顾家务，工作指令是否恰当？主人于家中设置监察镜头、家佣工作时大玩视像直播，可有触犯法例？冒失外佣经常损毁家中物品，雇主索偿原来有限额。保险公司代表则细述有关家庭佣工的保险须知。

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#7粤PG
programme.desc: 骏升吩咐林磊一定要比冠一早一步找到私生子。曦昕拿着剩下的泥码大感徬徨，柏义突然亲她一下，令筹码跌出，竟开始让她赢钱，骏升答应让曦昕加入赌场。印度赌王阿星到果栏挑战「雀后」，家聪应战却输掉了店舖招牌。正花找阿星取回招牌，兆良怕她出事，赶往营救。冠一、丁权找到照相馆的旧员工阿昌，向他问话时，突然有一堆人捉走阿昌。冠一质问骏升，骏升反指他自作主张、工作不力。柏义收到老人院电话，慌忙赶去。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#48粤
programme.desc: 明辉清早上班前，要让出地方给剑棠梳洗，导致上班迟到。剑棠特意为明辉配搭衣著，可惜他的品味甚差，令明辉被同事们取笑。剑棠不满广告效果不如理想，竟要家玲下令停播，二人争执，混乱中以墨水笔弄污家玲的衣服，误会更深。剑棠自广告播出后深受欢迎，并接获新广告，明辉指此乃家玲功劳。剑棠向家玲道歉，并请众人到别墅玩乐，剑棠与家玲划艇期间，再次针锋相对，不欢而散。

programme.title: 骊歌行#43粤普
programme.desc: 大将军盛骁靖之子盛楚慕对绣坊商户家的小姐傅柔一见倾心。本来不学无术的他遂决心学习兵法武艺来赢得傅柔的青睐。确定心意的二人回到长安，傅柔展转间成为女官，盛楚慕也被迫加入军队，携手为国家和百姓作出贡献。

programme.title: 娱乐大家粤
programme.desc: 麦玲玲师傅睇面相有心得，却被读唇拼句子考起，幸得上届港姐冠军陈晓华帮手。也多得晓华，张彦博才可领悟阿姐的「不醉」魔法，惟泰臣仍一脸茫然……晓华在「狼人」抽中当刺客，与刺客王郭子豪互踩，成功保护另外两名同党。另边厢，将军突然查杀一位公认的坏人，浪费了功能，更招杀身祸！「真假话题」，玲玲师傅提到曾为女生三小时内觅得情缘，众人深信真实因家族成员谭嘉仪常有类似遭遇？彦博曾被朋友公开全裸片段，嘉仪竟又知情？

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄罗斯经典动画系列新作！欢乐悠闲的罗莎渡假村，欢迎世界各地的旅客，在此度过最放松的假期！然而，调皮的狼总是想和兔子一争高下，借此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 功夫莫特
programme.desc: 莫特跟随师父修行了十年，但一直都只能处理一些和修练无关的琐事，某天，他们的村庄被妖怪入侵，师父命令莫特去解救村民，并嘱咐不可以真面貌示人，执行任务时，必须带著一个奇怪面具。对于这样的指示，莫特并不开心。因为所有的村民，包括他暗恋的妙仙，都非常崇拜著面具道士，所以莫特越来越想告诉大家真相…

programme.title: 灿烂的风和海
programme.desc: 【赛车手失意澳门 邂逅冷艳策展人共度浪漫情缘】在灯火辉煌的摄影棚与璀璨夺目的澳门之间，广告导演麦又歌为梦想与责任奔波，结识热心单纯的机车青年徐君乐，在彼此的陪伴下逐渐打开封闭的心门。同时，赛车手韩俊豪在失利阴影与媒体质疑中挣扎，却因邂逅神秘策展人陈嘉慧，而重新燃起追寻自我的勇气。四人在工作、梦想与爱情的交织里相遇，既面对现实的压力，也学会倾听心底的渴望。在陌生却绚烂的城市里，他们将一同经历命运的考验，找寻属于自己的方向。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力妈搭配毒舌女母女笑闹同居火花不断】一个是凡事冲动、毫无对策的妈妈，一个是洒脱率性、走自己路的女儿。原本就像陌生人一样的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，鸡飞狗跳成为日常。从降职的糗事、误会的桃色风波，到接连不断的麻烦事件，她们在斗嘴中暗暗守护彼此。越是嫌弃对方，越是离不开对方——这场「陌生人同居记」，意外写下母女间最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宫中权力的美室，一心想成为王后，虽然摩耶王后在她的诡计下死里逃生，还身怀六甲回到宫中，但摩耶王后怀的双胞胎却成就不幸的宿命，因为王室流传一个预言——「御出双生，圣骨男尽」，意指王室若生出双胞胎，将使王室男性断了精气。真平王深知要是王后生下双胞胎的事实曝光，一家人将会有无止尽的灾难，于是命宫女昭火偷偷将其中一个女儿带出王宫。多年后被抛弃的公主德曼回到新罗，与双胞胎姐姐天明公主同心协力对抗美室。美室企图用各种手段罗织罪名于德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主于一场追捕德曼的阴谋计划下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新罗的德曼公主因为天明公主的死开始藉著聪慧的头脑与身旁各方势力的协助，最终击垮政敌美室，成为第一个登上新罗王位的女性。

programme.title: Remember-儿子的战争
programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.title: 善德女王(完)
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宫中权力的美室，一心想成为王后，虽然摩耶王后在她的诡计下死里逃生，还身怀六甲回到宫中，但摩耶王后怀的双胞胎却成就不幸的宿命，因为王室流传一个预言——「御出双生，圣骨男尽」，意指王室若生出双胞胎，将使王室男性断了精气。真平王深知要是王后生下双胞胎的事实曝光，一家人将会有无止尽的灾难，于是命宫女昭火偷偷将其中一个女儿带出王宫。多年后被抛弃的公主德曼回到新罗，与双胞胎姐姐天明公主同心协力对抗美室。美室企图用各种手段罗织罪名于德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主于一场追捕德曼的阴谋计划下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新罗的德曼公主因为天明公主的死开始藉著聪慧的头脑与身旁各方势力的协助，最终击垮政敌美室，成为第一个登上新罗王位的女性。

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.desc: 哈皮和乐奇是邻居，他们跟帕普和邦迪一起住在乡下。哈皮和乐奇之间相处得很愉快，他们的生活充满了搞笑和欢乐。

programme.title: 哈皮乐奇闹翻天
programme.desc: 哈皮和乐奇是邻居，他们跟帕普和邦迪一起住在乡下。哈皮和乐奇之间相处得很愉快，他们的生活充满了搞笑和欢乐。

programme.title: 灿烂的风和海
programme.desc: 【赛车手失意澳门 邂逅冷艳策展人共度浪漫情缘】在灯火辉煌的摄影棚与璀璨夺目的澳门之间，广告导演麦又歌为梦想与责任奔波，结识热心单纯的机车青年徐君乐，在彼此的陪伴下逐渐打开封闭的心门。同时，赛车手韩俊豪在失利阴影与媒体质疑中挣扎，却因邂逅神秘策展人陈嘉慧，而重新燃起追寻自我的勇气。四人在工作、梦想与爱情的交织里相遇，既面对现实的压力，也学会倾听心底的渴望。在陌生却绚烂的城市里，他们将一同经历命运的考验，找寻属于自己的方向。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力妈搭配毒舌女母女笑闹同居火花不断】一个是凡事冲动、毫无对策的妈妈，一个是洒脱率性、走自己路的女儿。原本就像陌生人一样的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，鸡飞狗跳成为日常。从降职的糗事、误会的桃色风波，到接连不断的麻烦事件，她们在斗嘴中暗暗守护彼此。越是嫌弃对方，越是离不开对方——这场「陌生人同居记」，意外写下母女间最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 善德女王(完)
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宫中权力的美室，一心想成为王后，虽然摩耶王后在她的诡计下死里逃生，还身怀六甲回到宫中，但摩耶王后怀的双胞胎却成就不幸的宿命，因为王室流传一个预言——「御出双生，圣骨男尽」，意指王室若生出双胞胎，将使王室男性断了精气。真平王深知要是王后生下双胞胎的事实曝光，一家人将会有无止尽的灾难，于是命宫女昭火偷偷将其中一个女儿带出王宫。多年后被抛弃的公主德曼回到新罗，与双胞胎姐姐天明公主同心协力对抗美室。美室企图用各种手段罗织罪名于德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主于一场追捕德曼的阴谋计划下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新罗的德曼公主因为天明公主的死开始藉著聪慧的头脑与身旁各方势力的协助，最终击垮政敌美室，成为第一个登上新罗王位的女性。

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-儿子的战争
programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Cubby
programme.desc: In a funny and honest look at modern family life, Bluey, her sister Bingo and her friends use gameplay to integrate the adult world into their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Family Photo Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn that friends can be like an extended family.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Breakfast Badge
programme.desc: Tag's feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast, uh-oh!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken AE, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Chichen Itza, Mexico
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch's giant ball game threatens El Castillo in Chichen Itza, Mexico, so the Go Jetters attempt to save it.

programme.title: Roots Fruits (S2) - Avocado
programme.desc: The fabulous Avocados sing an operatic piece in their three unique voices.

programme.title: Roots Fruits (S2) - Banana
programme.desc: Banana reveals another secret about herself in the opera piece, "I've Got a Secret".

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Spooky Day
programme.desc: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but later realises she needs his help as she's stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Pea's Power Suit
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of Supertato, the world's first potato superhero as he tackles the mischievous Evil Pea, in the supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Together
programme.desc: Dipsy and Laa-Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Adapted from the renowned Chinese novel, The Water Margin, this is the story of a poor and beautiful girl Lotus Pan, who is raped by her master and had to be married off to a midget who treats her badly. Lost and lonely, Pan unwittingly becomes a pawn in the game of lust between her husband's playboy brother Wu Song, and a murderous man Men Ching.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Like legendary director Chu Yuan did so often and so successfully, Chang Peng Yi adapted this film from a story by Ku Lung. Following the footsteps of the equally legendary Chang Cheh, Chang also casted the majestic Ti Lung, along with "Venoms" Lo Meng and Sun Chien, for a spectacular showcase of mystical Martial Arts World's intrigue and consummate Kung Fu.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: Ah Kam, a seasoned prostitute, gets locked inside an ATM vestibule with a thief. Both discover they are ill-fated in life and Ah Kam starts telling him her life story as a prostitute, from a teenage hooker to a PR girl in an upscale club in her thirties, as well as being a strip dancer, bar girl and masseuse.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Follow the Lightning: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and the riders go in search of Thunder and must face a gauntlet of dangerous dragons to find their lost friend. Along the way, Tom reveals his big secret to D’Angelo and Alex.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Follow the Lightning: Part 2
programme.desc: Tom and the riders help Thunder, who is seeking revenge against the dragons that chased off his family.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Pteracopters
programme.desc: When Pteracopterscrash land in the Flatirons, Ty and crew must go behind enemy lines to save their fallen wingman from savage STEALTH SCRAPADACTYLS

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - A Time to Be Quiet, a Time to Be Loud
programme.desc: Raa Raa has spotted an exciting new thing in the jungle. What could it be? As they try to get close to the "flappy fly", Raa Raa discovers that some situations call for absolute quiet… not something our noisy little lion is very good at!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - The Right Sound
programme.desc: One of the pipes on Huffty's Toot Stick has broken. Can Raa Raa help his friend find the "right" sound to replace it in the jungle so they can play loud music together?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Huffty Loses His Voice
programme.desc: Huffty has lost his voice. While Raa Raa and his friends try and work out what has happened to it, Huffty has to mime to make himself understood.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa Finds A Voice
programme.desc: Raa Raa is upset when Topsy suggests that he should stick to doing "Raa Raa" things. He sets out to prove Topsy wrong. Will the noisy little lion learn that sometimes it's best just to be yourself?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Zebby's Snack Time
programme.desc: Zebby likes to have a snack when she is feeling tired. Raa Raa thinks this is a great idea and decides to join his friend. Except he thinks they should have their snack in the perfect place… but everywhere they try is just too noisy… I wonder why that could be?!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Finding Noisy
programme.desc: Raa Raa gets carried away when collecting fun noisy objects in the jungle with his friends. Raa Raa wants to keep everything he finds for himself, but soon discovers that his collection isn't much fun with nobody to share it with.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers
programme.desc: Kitty Ranger Team Leader Mama Box helps Kitty Ranger Gabby and Pandy get a lost Baby Me-Owl back home to its Mama in the Fairy Tale Garden. They embark on a hiking adventure! They learn about animal tracking, earn patches along the way, and ultimately, reunite Baby with Mama!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Hazardous Hysteria Of The Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months - everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - OCB
programme.desc: Boss' reign as CEO is threatened by a charming, multiple-dimpled Outside Consultant Baby (OCB) hired by the Board of Directors. Boss, furious that OCB will ruin Baby Corp with his poorly thought out ideas, tries to distract him while Staci adds the finishing touches to a project that will make OCB unnecessary, The 24 Hour Diaper.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Growing Paints
programme.desc: When Grug thinks his forehead looks too big in Ugga's family portrait, she strives to make the painting disappear.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - First Flight: Part 2
programme.desc: Tom forges a friendship with the dragon and discovers an entire world of dragons within the fissure.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Welcome Home, Everest!
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yi’s magic works, they notice that Everest isn’t looking too hot. In fact, he’s too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Scrapbookmobile Troll Rangers
programme.desc: When Biggie accidentally destroys a beloved scrapbook, he and Poppy set out to replace it by having a scrapbook-worthy adventure. CJ Suki and Priscilla embark on a journey to earn Junior Troll Ranger patches for mastering Trolly activities.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Picktools
